explicit_origin_contract.alignment: optional clause.premise_origins array must be one-to-one with clause.premises; each object repeats the exact premise string to prevent positional drift

kinds.excerpt: requires one or more exact selected evidence IDs whose immutable source quote contains the exact phrase, allowing whitespace-only line-wrap variation
kinds.stem: requires exact phrase in stem body and carries no source IDs
kinds.printed_option_input: requires exact phrase in the exact option for that row and can be used only when clause basis is arithmetic

explicit_origin_contract.ambiguity: without an explicit origin, a uniquely identifiable origin is inferred; if the same phrase matches multiple allowed origins, structural evaluation fails with premise_provenance_ambiguous
explicit_origin_contract.audit: semantic clause review must repeat the exact premise_origins array and resulting premise_bindings, bound to the exact matrix and evidence-catalog digests
fail_closed: printed option origin not in that row
unquoted option text asserted as excerpt

representative_tests: Repeated phrase in source and stem is rejected without explicit origin and passes only with excerpt origin plus matching audit entry.
Repeated numeric text in source and printed option is rejected without explicit arithmetic-input origin; explicit option input is distinct from the exact source rule.
A printed assertion cannot be marked excerpt unless the selected source quote actually contains it.
The independent semantic audit remains required after structurally valid explicit-origin binding.
V2 regression coverage remains inherited through the unchanged V2 freeze; V3 adds explicit-origin behavior and does not replace V2 artifacts.
